Title: Precognition and other Damage Prevention effects.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Greg Garson writes:
> I just need to clear this up in my mind. Cards like Precognition which
> have some damage prevention effects say "Prevent 1 damage" but don't
> specify if this can include aggravated damage or not. As such my
> question is can damage prevention cards that don't specify types of
> damage prevent aggravated damage?

Since it doesn't specify, it can prevent any type of damage (regular or
aggravated damage), so long as the damage is preventable in the first
place.

See superior Resilience for an example of a card that restricts its
usage to normal damage only.
